- Updated Camo Selector 1.6 (bug fixes)
- Updated Custom Sixth Sense 1.0.3 (further optimizations, animations are now png atlas files)

current.changeLog:
v2.3.0.1 #04 (17-06-2026):
- Updated enhanced modsSettingsApi 1.3.0 (every mod now has its own reset button by its on/off switch that restores that mod's options and hotkeys to defaults; a search box reachable with Ctrl+F to quickly find a mod by name; and new options for mod authors)
- Updated Tomato.gg (fixed playerpanels showing stats even when disabled)
- Updated BalCalcMod 2.3.5, AutoAim Indication+ 2.0.5 and Show vehicle body in the sniper view 2.0.3 (small internal fix: they no longer re-save their config needlessly on every game start)
- Updated Camo Selector 1.7 (added Style Share, custom styles now visible to other players using the mod, toggleable in the Customization menu)
- Updated Pet Gift Auto Claim (static texts now follow the installed game language; some languages still unsupported)
- Updated Research Progress Bar
